other_list: D3 ("Half the naive strength" for the Z_R N N vertex, severity substantive): the reconstruction claims the Majorana bilinear identity N̄ γ^μ P_R N = (1/2) N̄ γ^μ γ_5 N implies the Z_R N N vertex is purely axial with half the naive strength, but the paper's own Table II width Γ(Z_R → N_1 N_1) = 10.2 GeV (matched by the reconstruction's 10.18 GeV) is reproduced without any extra 1/2 factor; a literal 1/2 in the vertex would lower the rate by a factor of 4, to about 2.5 GeV.
note: The reviewer correctly finds the reconstruction matches the paper term-by-term and numerically on all nine partial widths, and correctly isolates the one real physics error (D3's unsupported vertex-strength claim), so a physicist reading this would be sent to the right place.
